spec_match.rationale: Aborts a real in-flight body with four reason shapes and audits every catch site the Fetch spec change touches — fetch promise, response.text(), the body stream reader and signal.reason — distinguishing carried from substituted.

interactive.rationale: Reason-shape and abort-timing selects plus Run drive genuine fetches of a large same-origin file; verified a run populated all four rows with honest per-site verdicts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises one request, one abort, four catch sites with recorded outcomes, which is the page.

edge_cases.rationale: No-reason (platform AbortError), string, object and Error reasons, plus abort-before-response and did-not-reject sites are all distinct handled states.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts exactly this page's contract per site; on Chromium 141 the route reported 5 pass / 2 fail with precisely the two Chrome-154 forwarding assertions (response.text and body stream) failing — the honest pre-154 result.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran object/after-headers — fetch promise did not reject, text() and the stream reader got substituted AbortErrors, signal.reason carried (1/3), and the detail correctly called it pre-154 behaviour; the only failed requests were the demo's own intentional ERR_ABORTED fetches.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and emits a reason-sites-checked assert with kind/when/carried counts.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, carried/lost verdicts as text plus colour, focusable code block, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live result readout, 44px controls.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document scrollWidth is 492px: the timing select's long option text ('after the response arrives, before reading the body') fixes the select's intrinsic width, clipping the stage, the note, the results table and the code block at the right edge (mobile screenshot read).

openQuestions.title: Fix the 360px overflow caused by the long select option
openQuestions.detail: The #when select's longest option makes its intrinsic width ~490px, so the whole page overflows to 492px at a 360px viewport and the stage/table/code block are clipped. Give the selects max-width:100% (plus min-width:0 in the flex row) and shorten the option labels ('after headers, before the body' / 'mid-request'), then re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/fetch-api-forward-reason-from-abortcontroller-to-fetch-response/reason-everywhere/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The demo ran a real abort against a genuinely streaming body and honestly showed the pre-154 state this feature fixes: reason carried only by signal.reason (1/3), generic AbortErrors substituted at text() and the stream reader, correctly narrated. Console clean; the ERR_ABORTED network entries are the demo's own intentional aborts (plus the injected conformance panel's). /conformance/ reported 5 pass / 2 fail — exactly the two forwarding assertions that need Chrome 154. The one real defect is a 492px-wide layout at 360px caused by the long select option, which fails mobile parity until fixed.
